description: The plot illustrates BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four methods shown as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 2 to 12 with major tick labels at 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, ranging from 25 to 33 with integer tick marks. The Consistency-CE series is drawn as a light purple dashed line with circular markers, increasing from about 25.8 at AL≈2.5 to about 31.4 at AL≈11.5, with intermediate points near 28.0 (AL≈4), 29.9 (AL≈6.5), and 30.9 (AL≈9). The Inconsistency-CE series is a darker purple dashed line with square markers, rising from about 26.0 at AL≈2.5 to about 31.4 at AL≈11.5, passing through approximately 28.1 (AL≈4), 29.9 (AL≈6.5), and 30.9 (AL≈9). The Inconsistency-CE-MP series is a blue dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 26.2 at AL≈2 to about 31.8 at AL≈11.5, with points around 28.0 (AL≈4), 30.2 (AL≈6.5), and 31.0 (AL≈9). The red series is a solid line with star markers, starting near 28.9 at AL≈3 and increasing to about 32.1 at AL≈11.5, with intermediate values around 29.6 (AL≈5), 31.2 (AL≈7.5), and 31.8 (AL≈10.5).
